race: Formula 1 MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix 2026

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Welcome to the Race Weekend Podcast, and Austin is buzzing because Kimi Antonelli can win the title on Sunday from pole position.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Pole, pressure, and a young champion on the brink, this is the kind of Austin weekend you do not want to miss before lights out here.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Michael, take us through the headlines before we get into the grid, because there is plenty to talk about today, and I mean plenty.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Antonelli took pole in the United States on the weekend he can clinch his first world title, and he sounds like he is enjoying it more than usual.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: And he says he is enjoying himself more than usual, which is a brilliant read for a title decider when the stakes are this high right now.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Exactly, no panic, just a title contender having fun while the championship hangs in the balance, and that is a good sign for Sunday at Austin.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Meanwhile Leclerc was fastest in practice, so Ferrari are not sleeping, and that should keep the front running honest into the race again.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: There are also some big grid penalties, including car five getting eighty places and car forty three getting ten, and that makes the start messy.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That should make the start even more chaotic, with drivers fighting for position before the first corner, and the bumps are there for everyone.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Let us talk top three, starting with Antonelli, because he is the man to beat from pole position, and he has the title in his sights this weekend.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: He has pole position, a dominant season, and Mercedes pace, but his Austin history is thin, so I want proof on Sunday afternoon in front of everyone.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: He has only one race here, averaging thirteen, so the track is not his old friend, but his form is the real story right now and that matters.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: But when a driver is on the brink of history, you respect the momentum, and Mercedes look ready to control the race from the first lap again.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Now Max Verstappen starts second and this is his kind of place, with strong recent wins behind him, and he knows the bumps cold.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: He averages one point seven, has three podiums, and a best win at Austin, so he is the perfect pole chaser when the car is on song this weekend.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Recent wins plus strong Austin form, how do you beat that, especially when Red Bull can be on the front foot at Austin on Sunday and it is tight?

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: You do not easily, but I like Charles Leclerc from fourth, because Ferrari have practice speed and race rhythm if they get the start right away.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Fastest practice, a good Austin record, and two podiums here, he is a real threat if he gets a clean opening lap and he has the pace for the win.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Ferrari can be on the front row in the race, even if they do not start there, and that is what makes this spicy, and the fans will love it.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: My deep cut is Isack Hadjar from third, because Red Bull pace and strong recent form make him a dangerous wildcard if the car sticks in the race.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Red Bull pace and strong recent form, that is dangerous, and a good start could put him into the podium conversation with Verstappen and Leclerc.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Add the grid shuffle, and the midfield can turn into a scrap, with Lewis Hamilton and George Russell both in the mix early in the race again.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I like Gasly tenth as a low confidence gamble, but his form is fading, so this is the one pick I am least sure about when the points are on the line.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Let us bring the rest of the top ten together, because the midfield is tight and the race can swing quickly with the title in view for Antonelli.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Hamilton fifth, Russell sixth, Norris seventh, Piastri eighth, Lawson ninth, Gasly tenth, and all can fight for points and pride all afternoon.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Here is the full top ten, and Paul has it ready to land before we say goodbye.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Full top ten, Antonelli, Verstappen, Leclerc, Hadjar, Hamilton, Russell, Norris, Piastri, Lawson, Gasly, Austin, title drama, we will see you at the start.
